title: Elev8 “The Dude Piece” Incycler
description:
Elev8 “The Dude Piece” Incycler
“The Dude Piece” Incycler is that just about perfect size that offers a decent amount of cooling while not taking much away from your vapour. They have really hit the mark with this one.
The elev8 “The Dude Piece” Incycler utilizes  a 14mm female glass joint.
Included
1 x Elev8 “The Dude Piece” Incycler
